regional.syndrome: Encephalitis with fulminant onset; case fatality ~30% and severe neurological sequelae in most survivors. Infection is rare but outbreaks cluster around freshwater swamp habitats.
regional.headline: The most lethal arbovirus endemic to North America.
regional.prevention: Mosquito avoidance and aerial larviciding during amplification; equine vaccine available, none for humans.
regional.geography: Atlantic and Gulf coasts of the United States, Great Lakes region, Caribbean.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.
